For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/understanding-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-plain-language-11. content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Digital product

A sovereign digital commerce stack is a complete infrastructure solution that allows creators to sell digital products without relying on conventional payment platforms that may not be available or affordable. This architecture is crucial for individuals in countries with restrictive financial systems, as it provides a way to bypass excessive fees and maintain ownership over their creations. By utilizing tools that support crypto payments, creators can ensure that they retain a larger portion of their revenue, enabling them to invest back into their business and expand their reach.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The core of this architecture relies on a combination of free and open-source tools. For hosting, platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages are utilized, offering reliable performance at no cost. Backend logic can be handled by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which processes user requests and manages data efficiently. Order storage is secured through Supabase or Google Sheets, while file delivery is facilitated through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, NOWPayments streamlines the payment process with its automatic crypto payment verification, allowing for seamless transactions with minimal fees.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where traditional payment gateways fall short. Whether you are selling ebooks, online courses, templates, or digital assets like fonts and plugins, this stack provides a solution that eliminates reliance on platforms like Gumroad or Payhip. By building their own store, creators can not only avoid high transaction fees but also enjoy the sovereignty of their digital assets, allowing for a more sustainable and profitable business model.
Retain more of your revenue with a 0.5% fee instead of 10%.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Every component in this architecture plays a critical role in creating a seamless experience for both the seller and the buyer. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serve as the storefront, while backend technologies like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script manage the logic behind transactions. Supabase or Google Sheets maintain order data, ensuring smooth operations. File delivery through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 guarantees that customers receive their purchases instantly. Finally, NOWPayments connects everything through its crypto payment gateway, providing an efficient and cost-effective way to process transactions.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy your own sovereign digital commerce stack, start by selecting a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for your store. Next, set up your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle transactions. Use Supabase or Google Sheets to store your order data, ensuring all transactions are recorded accurately. For file delivery, utilize Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 to make your products available to customers upon purchase. Finally, integrate NOWPayments to enable crypto payments and begin selling your products without the burden of high fees.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, you can set up your own digital store using a sovereign stack that utilizes crypto payments. This architecture allows you to retain more of your earnings, as it eliminates the high fees associated with traditional platforms. By using tools like NOWPayments, you can accept payments in various cryptocurrencies, ensuring a smooth transaction process without the need for KYC verification.
Complete ownership of your digital assets means no platform dependencies.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking to explore further, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197) which includes everything you need to deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack. This kit offers all six blueprints and seven templates, ensuring a comprehensive setup for your digital product store. Check it out at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions
How can I sell digital downloads without platform fees?

You can create your own digital store using a sovereign stack, which allows you to bypass conventional platforms. By utilizing free tools and integrating NOWPayments for crypto transactions, you significantly reduce fees and maintain control over your sales.
What tools do I need to build my digital store?

You’ll need a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, a backend solution such as Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, an order storage method like Supabase or Google Sheets, and a delivery system through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, alongside NOWPayments for accepting crypto payments.
Can I sell courses and ebooks using this method?

Absolutely. This infrastructure is designed for digital creators looking to sell various products, including ebooks and online courses. The tools allow for easy setup and management of your digital products.
Is there a way to automate product delivery?
Yes, by using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file storage, you can automate product delivery. When a purchase is confirmed through NOWPayments, customers receive their products instantly.
What are the benefits of using NOWPayments?

NOWPayments offers low transaction fees at 0.5% and supports over 300 cryptocurrencies. It requires no KYC and does not necessitate a buyer account, making it straightforward for both sellers and customers.
